name: GitHub
comments: GitHub runs on Azure with renewable energy commitments. ~5g CO₂/month and ~0.1 kWh/month per active repository is a conservative proxy for storage and CI/CD.

name: S3 / Static Hosting
description: Asset storage and static file hosting, for demo and staging environments only.
comments: Estimate based on ~0.001 kgCO₂/GB transferred at ~8 GB/month. Energy estimate: ~0.5 kWh/month.

name: Claude Code (AI)
description: Occasional AI assistance for tools, CI/CD scripts or documentation.
comments: Based on my own Claude Code logs for occasional use (real request and token counts), converted to energy with TokenAtlas estimates drawn from published research.

name: Claude Code (AI)
description: AI-assisted development for refactoring, code review, or feature development.
comments: Based on my own Claude Code logs for daily AI-assisted work (real request and token counts), converted to energy with TokenAtlas estimates drawn from published research.

name: Gmail (Google Workspace)
comments: Counted actual sent mail: ~40 emails over 20 workdays (~2/day). 40 emails/month × 0.3g CO₂/email = 12g CO₂/month. kWh estimated at ~0.001 kWh/email → 0.04 kWh/month. Google Workspace runs on carbon-neutral infrastructure.

name: Claude Code (agentic)
description: Continuous agentic AI use throughout the project, with Claude Code acting directly on the codebase.
comments: Based on my own Claude Code logs for continuous agentic work (real request and token counts), converted to energy with TokenAtlas estimates drawn from published research.
